endpoints.instruction: Wait outside the showroom; branch staff bring the vehicle out for inspection and key release.

steps.why: Order shows pickup and delivery endpoints with open verification items; read every message on the order for the escalation, its authors and any customer or driver statements.

messages.body: Earliest vehicle crossing returned sold out. A later crossing is only a quote. The assigned driver is based away from Marseille; positioning, rest and the customer promise still need a reviewed plan.
I can collect from Marseille tomorrow if my trip there is confirmed. Please send the actual travel booking, not just a suggested route.
We are checking the route and vehicle space. The pickup slot and delivery promise have not been changed. We will ask before proposing a later handover.
Please keep the agreed attended delivery window. If the route cannot make it, send the revised date and reason for approval before contacting the recipient at the home address.

Compare the available crossing with road time, driver rest, check-in and arrival at the private delivery address. Neither the crossing quote nor positioning quote is a purchase. Escalate if the promise needs revision and confirm the recipient separately.

args.text: Ops here. No trip is booked yet; these are quotes only. Please confirm if you can take it, and whether you need any rest before the ferry leg on 2026-10-25.

steps.why: The driver is based in Bordeaux and the pickup depends on positioning to Marseille and rest before the 25 Oct crossing; a driver answer is the cheapest way to test feasibility before any human books anything.

known.fact: The earliest ferry (23 Oct 22:00Z, check-in cut-off 23 Oct 20:00Z) is SOLD_OUT: vehicle space unavailable and no booking exists.
No failed booking attempt and no reservation are on record, so there is no unknown outcome to reconcile before a new booking.
The 25 Oct 10:00Z ferry is AVAILABLE_QUOTE at EUR 570 (quote_cents 57000), check-in cut-off 2026-10-25T08:00Z, arrives 2026-10-26T15:00Z. It is a quote only; no reservation exists.

Timing for the 25 Oct ferry: the terminal is reachable before cut-off (worst-case margin 47h) if the 22 Oct pickup ends at 11:00Z and the 22h road leg is driven. Overnight is needed. Breaks and traffic are excluded.

With that ferry the vehicle arrives 26 Oct 15:00Z and the delivery window ends 27 Oct 14:00Z, so it is still reachable with 23h margin. The 3h terminal-to-address leg is an assumption, not from the data.
The 26 Oct 22:00Z ferry (EUR 650, quote only) arrives 28 Oct 03:00Z, after the delivery window ends on 27 Oct 14:00Z. It cannot meet the current promise.

Northrail train quotes Bordeaux to Marseille, not purchased: EUR 113 departing 21 Oct 21:00Z (arrives 22 Oct 04:00Z), and EUR 151 departing 22 Oct 00:00Z (arrives 07:00Z). The local transfer is not confirmed.

Pickup is at Marseille, 22 Oct 08:00Z to 11:00Z, and the pickup endpoint is confirmed. Delivery is 27 Oct 10:00Z to 14:00Z, and the delivery endpoint (home address) is not confirmed: contact UNCONFIRMED and access NEEDS_VERIFICATION.

Assigned driver drv-464 is based in Bordeaux with fee EUR 2334. The driver will collect from Marseille tomorrow only if the trip is confirmed. options.title: Ask the customer to approve a revised delivery promise on the 26 Oct ferry
options.eta: Ferry arrives 2026-10-28T03:00Z, after the current window ends 27 Oct 14:00Z. Delivery date to be set with the customer.
options.downside: Breaks the attended delivery window the customer asked to keep. The customer must approve first and the recipient cannot be contacted before approval. Cost is EUR 650 for the quote, which is not a booking.

steps.detail: A person asks the customer to approve a revised date and reason, citing the sold-out crossing. Operations asks; the agent does not contact the customer.

steps.detail: After approval, revise the delivery window to match the 28 Oct arrival. The current window is 27 Oct 10:00Z to 14:00Z.
steps.label: Change the delivery promise (a person does this)

steps.detail: Only after approval, buy travel-xae55f19d2d6ecd88 (EUR 650, quote_cents 65000, check-in cut-off 2026-10-26T20:00Z).
steps.label: Book the ferry

options.compensation: If the customer declines, keep the original promise and fall back to option A or escalate. Do not buy the ferry. No booking exists until the ferry is purchased, so nothing needs cancelling before then.

final.decision: Approve option A (buy the EUR 113 train for the driver and hold the EUR 570 ferry) or start option B (ask the customer to approve a later delivery).
